edges.reason: transfer() is invoked by msg.sender, which becomes the transfer sender.
transferFrom() uses msg.sender as the spender whose allowance is debited.
approve() writes _allowances[msg.sender][spender] with caller-controlled amount.
removeLiquidty is gated by onlyOwner comparing owner() to _msgSender().
setFees is gated by onlyOwner, so caller identity decides fee configuration.
setResetPeriodInSeconds is gated by onlyOwner and controls ring timing.
vamos launch is gated by onlyOwner and enables the token.
addBlacklist is gated by onlyOwner and restricts other users.
recoverLosteth sends the whole balance to the caller, gated by onlyOwner.
recoverLostTokens sends arbitrary tokens to the caller, gated by onlyOwner.
Ring rotation, biggestBuy comparison and 3 hour hold window depend on block.timestamp.
Blacklisting is only allowed while block.timestamp < _launchTime + 45 minutes.
_reset writes block.timestamp into lastRingChange.
vamos stores block.timestamp into _launchTime, controlling the blacklist window.
swapBack passes block.timestamp as the router deadline.
_reset overwrites lastRingChange.
_checkTxLimit reads lastRingChange to decide whether to reset the ring.
resetPeriod is compared against elapsed time in _checkTxLimit.
transferFrom decrements _allowances before moving tokens.
approve writes the allowance mapping.
takeFee credits the fee amount into _balances[address(this)].
_transferFrom rejects transfers involving blacklisted addresses.
Ring address and its computed ETH share are passed to the raw call.
marketingWallet address and its computed ETH share are passed to the raw call.
takeFee computes feeAmount = amount * feeApplicable / 100 using totalFee-based values.
swapBack divides by totalFee, which removeLiquidty can set to zero, risking division by zero.
liquidityFee selects the liquidity portion of tokens and ETH in swapBack.
ringFee selects the ring holder ETH share in swapBack.
_transferFrom calls _checkTxLimit before applying fees.
_transferFrom calls takeFee to compute the net amount.
_transferFrom triggers swapBack, which performs external ETH calls before balances are settled.
_transferFrom delegates to _basicTransfer while the swap lock is active.
_transferFrom calls isWalletToWallet to block wallet-to-wallet transfers.
_transferFrom calls autoBlacklist(recipient) when the token is not yet launched.
_checkTxLimit calls _reset when the reset period has elapsed.
takeFee returns the post-fee amount back to _transferFrom.
swapBack makes a raw ETH call to marketingWallet before all accounting is finished.
swapBack makes a raw ETH call to Ring (an attacker-influenceable address) before state writes.
recoverLosteth pushes the entire balance to msg.sender via transfer.
recoverLostTokens calls transfer on an arbitrary owner-specified token.
swapBack swaps accumulated tokens for ETH through the router.
swapBack adds ETH liquidity through the router.
_payOut[Ring] is written after the external ETH call to marketingWallet.
_payOut[Ring] is written after the external ETH call to Ring.
previousRingHolder[Ring] is set after the external ETH call.
_lastRingTimer[Ring] is set after the external ETH call.
marketingWallet fallback can re-enter the transfer path during swapBack.
Ring fallback can re-enter the transfer path while swapBack is mid-execution.
Router swap calls back into the token transfer hook before swapBack finalizes.
addLiquidityETH triggers token transfers back into this contract.
